description: This file defines the ReadOnlyFilesystemCache class in the Twig templating engine, which extends FilesystemCache to implement a cache that is read-only. The class overrides the write method to prevent any modifications to the cache.

classes.name: ReadOnlyFilesystemCache
classes.description: A subclass of FilesystemCache that disables write operations to enforce read-only cache behavior.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to prevent writing to the cache; does nothing.
